conviction_note: Lean up but small: company documents point to a beat on a guide it has beaten (Q2 +5.7% vs guide midpoint) and to demand strong enough to fund a $400M rapid-ramp expansion, while the Q4 guide will be muddied by the Epiq ($1.1B, debt-funded, EPS-dilutive into 2027) and STG/ILFA consolidation and puts are bid (skew +8.3); findings sum +2.1 but p_up is held at 55 because this name has sold beats three times out of seven and the skew argues the other way, so the scaled number (+1.0) is half the sum.
bar: Company guide Q3 2026 net sales $1.10-1.14B, non-GAAP EPS $1.21-1.27 (8-K 2026-08-06, https://investors.ttm.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-336163/d132953dex991.htm); consensus about $1.13B revenue (Benzinga) and EPS $1.22 (Benzinga) / $1.25 (Yahoo, 4 analysts, range 1.24-1.26), so two sources roughly agree inside the guide. The implied Q4 bar is the hard one: FY2026 'approximately $4.4B' less Q1 $846M, Q2 $1,004M and Q3 midpoint $1,120M leaves about $1.43B organic for Q4 (+28% q/q), which the Q4 guide must meet; the Q4 guide will also be the first to include Epiq (closed 2026-09-30) and possibly STG/ILFA, so its comparison to consensus is not clean.

findings.finding: TTM beat its own revenue guide by a wide margin last quarter: Q2 2026 net sales $1,004M against a $930-970M guide (+5.7% vs the $950M midpoint) and $962M consensus, with non-GAAP EPS $0.99 vs $0.82-0.88 guided; on the Q2 call management said M+N (asymmetric AI PCB) full production had started with yields 'better than expected', about $600M of M+N in H2 split one-third Q3 / two-thirds Q4, and margin improvement in Q3 and Q4. A repeat beat of similar size puts Q3 revenue near $1.16B against the $1.13B consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (bmo 2026-08-06): a 5.7% revenue beat plus a FY raise to $4.4B bought +3.89%. The +15.07% (2026-04-29) and +16.63% (2025-04-30) moves came with strong guides; three of the seven prints in the baseline (2026-02-04 -3.78, 2025-10-29 -2.44, 2025-07-30 -3.04) were sold, so a beat on the reported quarter alone has not reliably paid.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus sits inside the guide ($1.13B / $1.22-1.25) rather than at the level of the Q2 beat pattern; if the street had carried a repeat 5% beat, consensus would sit above the top of the guide ($1.14B) and the stock would not be 54% off its high with downside skew bid.
findings.independence: The company's own Q2 release (https://investors.ttm.com/sec-filings/all-sec-filings/content/0001193125-26-336163/d132953dex991.htm), the same quarter's document set, so this is one source family; peer read in the separate Amphenol/Gold Circuit finding.

findings.finding: On 2026-10-12, inside the quarter's reporting gap, TTM announced $400M of incremental 'Rapid-Ramp' brownfield capacity for N+M asymmetric AI interconnect at four China plants and Penang, on top of the $1.2B 2025-2029 plan, with the CEO stating 'the rapid growth in demand requires us to make rapid capacity increases' and citing ongoing discussions with hyperscaler, data-center and networking customers. That is company-level evidence that demand runs above the capacity behind the $4.4B FY outlook, which supports a Q4 guide at or above the implied ~$1.43B and the 2027 framework.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance raises drove this name's two largest up moves (+15.07% 2026-04-29, +16.63% 2025-04-30); the Q2 FY raise from 'at least $4B' to $4.4B bought +3.89%.
findings.why_not_priced: The stock fell from about $126 on 2026-10-01 to $93.88 on 2026-10-16 after the announcement, in a sector AI-hardware selloff, so the market read the capex as cash out rather than as a demand signal; if the demand were priced, the stock would not be at -20% over 20 days with puts bid into the print. The release gave no numbers and deferred detail to the Q3 call, so the call is where the demand gets quantified.
findings.independence: Q2 call (separate document) said M+N yields beat plan and backlog was $901M 90-day, +81% y/y, book-to-bill 1.49: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001116942/000119312526337923/d142017dex992.htm

findings.finding: On the Q2 call management reaffirmed 15-20% organic growth for 2027 and 2028 and said a longer-term plan would follow 'next quarter', i.e. on or around this Q3 call; a first multi-year target set (plus first commentary on Epiq/STG/ILFA/Ophir integration) is new information on the line this stock trades on, with the sign unknown and the size large.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior long-term-target event in the baseline; guide-driven prints moved 15-17% when strong.
findings.why_not_priced: The street cannot model a target that has not been given; the 87.8% ATM IV and 9.2% event move are consistent with the market expecting a large move but the skew does not tell which way; a reaffirmed 15-20% organic plus acquisitions would put 2027 revenue well above what a $100 stock at roughly 20x the 'approach $5.00' FY26 EPS discounts.
findings.independence: Same call transcript as finding 1 (shared document); no separate source confirms the timing of the plan.

findings.finding: The Q4 guide will be the first to consolidate Epiq Solutions ($1.1B cash, 17.4x synergy-adjusted 2027 EBITDA, closed 2026-09-30, funded by $300M TLA + $800M TLB + $500M 6.75% notes due 2034) and possibly STG/ILFA, with net leverage stepping from 0.9x to about 2.3x at close and Ophir Optics ($650M on the revolver, announced 2026-10-19, closing Q2 2027) on top; the company itself says Epiq is moderately dilutive to non-GAAP EPS in 2027. Roughly $1.6B of new debt at ~6.5-7% is about $25M a quarter of interest, so a headline Q4 EPS guide can land below an organic street number even if the business is on plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Epiq announcement (2026-08-17/18): the stock fell, with auto-alerts citing -5.7% pre-market and -10.8% in the session; no prior print has carried an acquisition-diluted guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock has already de-rated hard on the M&A and leverage (54% off the high). What is not priced is the mechanics of the first consolidated guide: consensus for Q4 on aggregators (Q3 EPS $1.22-1.25) was formed on an organic basis, and a revenue guide jumping on acquisitions while EPS guidance absorbs interest can read as a miss on the wire. Financing answer (lesson 4): the money buys defense/RF businesses at a high multiple, not the AI ramp, so this is a negative on the guide line, sized small because the de-rating already reflects it.
findings.independence: Epiq deal terms and leverage path in the 2026-08-17 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1116942/000119312526353148/d375900dex991.htm); notes terms in the 2026-09-24 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1116942/000119312526401013/d186334d8k.htm); Ophir funding on the revolver (https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/ttm-technologies-to-acquire-ophir-optics-for-650-million-93CH-4957311).

findings.why_not_priced: Public for two months and the stock has fallen about 10% since, so it is mostly a statement about management confidence rather than unpriced information; a small weight only.

findings.finding: Kingboard raised FR-4 laminate and prepreg prices repeatedly through Q3 (+15% on 2026-06-16, +15% on 2026-07-06, +10-20% on 2026-08-28, another +15% on 2026-10-13, citing fiberglass cloth and copper foil), and TTM itself flagged tight lower-end laminate supply on the Q2 call; that is input-cost pressure on the non-AI half of the mix (automotive 8%, parts of MI&I) for Q3 gross margin and the Q4 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Gross margin has been rising (non-GAAP 21.9% in Q2, +100bp y/y); no print in the baseline turned on margin compression.
findings.source_date: 2026-08 (URL path) with the timeline updated to 2026-10-13
findings.why_not_priced: A secondary-source industry proxy; TTM's high-end AI materials are said on the call to remain available, and the company guided margin up, so this is a small offset rather than a call. Net of the rest: the 40-49% data-center mix and 32-37% A&D are on different materials and pricing.
findings.independence: TTM's own Q2 call comment on tight lower-end laminate (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001116942/000119312526337923/d142017dex992.htm); proxy, not confirmed in TTM's numbers.

findings.finding: Counterparties that spoke after TTM's Q2 report point to intact AI board demand: Amphenol guided another mid-teens sequential increase in IT datacom for Q3 (2026-07-29) and Gold Circuit Electronics, an AI-server PCB peer, posted a record NT$10.0B July revenue (+77% y/y) and said Q3 would rise sequentially on delayed shipments and new Taiwan/Thailand capacity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Data Center & Networking grew 91% y/y in Q2 and was 40% of sales, guided to 49% of Q3; the stock bought the Q2 print +3.89%.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer demand is public and the sector sold off anyway in mid-October on AI-financing worries; this is a proxy that says the demand side of the guide is not the risk, sized small.
findings.independence: Gold Circuit July 2026 revenue (https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/6418300); proxy, not TTM's number.

findings.why_not_priced: Positioning itself is priced by definition; the point is that the de-rating is sector and M&A, so a clean operating print has room, while the skew still says the option market expects downside. Small.

baseline_tension: What I found leans up against a +8.3 downside skew and a -20% 20-day run-up; the run-up is sector- and M&A-driven, which is why I hold a positive lean at all, but the skew and the first acquisition-consolidated guide are the reason p_up sits at 55 rather than 60.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a reaction): reported-quarter beat cut from +1.5 to +1.0 because three of seven prints were sold and a 5.7% beat with a raise bought only +3.9%
Lesson 7 (skew): positive demand/capex finding cut from +1.5 to +1.2 since the market saw the 2026-10-12 release and sold the stock, and p_up moved 56 -> 55 against the +8.3 skew
Lesson 5 (proxies and drawdowns): laminate proxy -0.5 -> -0.4, peer proxy +0.5 -> +0.3, sector-drawdown positioning +0.5 -> +0.3 (cause identified, but not a company number)

Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what the Epiq/notes/TLB money buys (defense/RF M&A at 17.4x, not the AI ramp) and kept the M&A guide finding negative at -1.0; the $400M capex funds the visible AI ramp and stays positive
CEO purchase +0.3 -> +0.2 as a two-month-old public fact
Lesson 6: bar sourced to the company guide plus two estimate sources; the implied Q4 bar (~$1.43B) stated; Ophir close moved to outside_window
